# The Ivy Bar and Kitchen

> Neighborhood bar & restaurant in Lakeview, Chicago, three blocks from Wrigley Field. Serves Chicago Tavern & Detroit Pan pizza, smash burgers, and craft cocktails, with rooftop and private event space.

Address: 1625 W Irving Park Rd, Chicago, IL 60613
Phone: (773) 799-8160
Neighborhood: Lakeview / Wrigleyville, Chicago — three blocks from Wrigley Field
Cuisine: American, Pizza, Bar Food
Price range: $$

## Hours

- Monday–Wednesday: 3:00 PM – Midnight
- Thursday: 11:00 AM – Midnight
- Friday–Saturday: 11:00 AM – 1:00 AM
- Sunday: 11:00 AM – Midnight

Rooftop hours (weather permitting):

- Monday–Thursday: 3:00 PM – 10:00 PM
- Friday–Saturday: 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM
- Sunday: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM

## Pages

- [Menus](https://theivybk.com/menu): Full food, pizza, beer, cocktail, and wine menu
- [Reservations](https://theivybk.com/#reserve): Request a table
- [Private Events](https://theivybk.com/private-events): Book the rooftop or dining room for private events, including fantasy sports draft parties (the semi-private dining room has a 98" TV)
- [Careers](https://theivybk.com/careers): Current openings and how to apply
- [Order Online](https://order.toasttab.com/online/the-ivy-1625-west-irving-park-road): Order pickup or delivery direct

## Specials

- Monday: Half off pizza with a drink purchase (dine-in only)
- Tuesday: $3 tacos, $6 Modelos, $9 margaritas (dine-in only)
- Wednesday: Burger & beer combo, $20 (dine-in only)
- Thursday: Salad, truffle fries & a glass of wine, $30 (select wines, dine-in only)
- Happy Hour Monday–Thursday, 3–5pm: $1 off draft/cans/bottles, $2 off wine, $3 off cocktails
- Night Caps Friday & Saturday, 10pm–12am: $10 signature cocktails
- Trivia Night every Wednesday, 7–9pm, hosted by Geeks Who Drink
- Bears Bingo: free bingo cards at the bar every Bears game, first bingo wins a prize
- IU game days: the Hoosier menu (Hoosierita $15, Hoosier Pizza $27, Upland Hoosier Gameday Lager 16 oz can $7), with 15% of its sales going to the IUAA Chicago Chapter Scholarship Fund

## Notes

- Two pizza styles: Chicago Tavern (thin, crisp, cut in squares) and Detroit Pan (golden crust, crispy corners), plus build-your-own.
- Rooftop seating, full bar, private event space, and TVs throughout the bar, dining room, and rooftop — a regular stop before Cubs games and Wrigley Field concerts.
- Gluten-free beer options and a Beyond patty swap are available; several menu items are vegetarian-friendly.
- Reservations recommended for parties of six or more, and on game days and concert nights.
